title: New species of ground-dwelling bird, the largest of its kind, identified in same cave as Homo floresiensis
title_zh: 弗洛勒斯岛发现史上最大型史前地栖鸟类化石
summary_zh: 考古学家在发掘“弗洛勒斯人（Homo floresiensis）”化石的Liang Bua洞穴中，鉴定出了一块被尘封已久的巨大鸟类腿骨，这是该地区已知最大的地栖鸟类遗骸。
snippet: In 2009, researchers working in the Liang Bua cave on Flores Island came across a leg bone. The 190,000–120,000-year-old fossil was identified as a bird bone and set aside. Like many bird bones before it, it was overlooked and left to collect dust.

title: Game theory helps SETI search for alien civilizations
title_zh: 博弈论或助力地外文明搜寻（SETI）
summary_zh: 研究人员指出，搜寻地外智慧生命时，不仅要考虑“在哪里看”，还要结合博弈论（game theory）推断“何时看”，以提高捕捉到地外文明信号的概率。
snippet: The search for extraterrestrial intelligence (SETI) is mostly concerned with where to look for technosignatures from another civilization. Between 2012 and 2015, SETI's Project Phoenix targeted about 1,000 sun-like stars for signs of intelligent life. But where to look might not be as important as when to look, according to scientists at SETI.

title: NASA Announces $1 Million to Students for Moon Base Challenge
title_zh: NASA启动百万美元月球基地设计竞赛
summary_zh: NASA面向美国在校学生发起“月球基地学生挑战赛”，旨在征集月球基地设计方案，以支持阿尔忒弥斯（Artemis）计划。
snippet: On Sunday, NASA announced the opening of its $1 million Moon Base Student Challenge during a MAX POWER event at Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex in Florida. As part of a Golden Age of Science, the competition invites student teams at U.S. high schools and post-secondary schools to contribute designs for the Moon Base. “We’re […]

title: 'Stupendously large' primordial black holes ruled out as a dark matter source
title_zh: 研究排除“超大”原始黑洞作为暗物质来源的可能性
summary_zh: 科学家通过观测分析排除了“超大”原始黑洞（primordial black holes）构成的暗物质理论，这类黑洞假设源于宇宙早期高密度物质的坍缩，而非恒星演化。
snippet: Primordial black holes are hypothetical objects that could have formed directly from dense clumps of matter in the very early universe. If they exist, their dramatic origins would set them apart from the black holes we see today, which form when massive stars collapse. Some theories suggest that "stupendously large" primordial black holes could account for a significant share of the universe's elusive dark matter.

title: Physicists listened to electrical noise to crack a superconductor mystery
title_zh: 物理学家通过分析电子噪声破解超导体谜题
summary_zh: 研究人员通过监测电子的电噪声（electronic noise）来判断电子是否形成了配对，这一发现有助于深入理解超导（superconductivity，即电阻消失的物理现象）机理。
snippet: Tuning in to electronic noise can tell us whether electrons have paired up or not.

title: Want to fly to the moon? NASA is looking for new astronauts to help grow its Artemis program
title_zh: NASA开启新一轮宇航员选拔，助力月球探索
summary_zh: NASA正式向社会公开招募新一批宇航员，旨在扩充人才储备，推进阿尔忒弥斯（Artemis）计划及月球基地建设任务。
snippet: Want to fly to the moon and help build a permanent lunar base? NASA is accepting applications for a new astronaut class that will help grow the Artemis program.

title: Chimp sanctuary delivers an ape's food by drone amid Florida floods
title_zh: 佛州洪水期间无人机为黑猩猩运送食物
summary_zh: 受严重洪灾影响，佛罗里达州一家黑猩猩收容所使用无人机为受困动物运送食物，确保了动物的安全。
snippet: A Florida chimpanzee sanctuary had to deliver food to one of its 200 apes by drone this week because the property was swamped by heavy rain. But the animals stayed safe, and the water finally was receding significantly on Saturday, the organization said.

title: A nuclear blast could save Earth from an asteroid, but there's a catch
title_zh: 核爆拯救地球免受小行星撞击或存在局限性
summary_zh: 研究发现，利用核爆炸改变危险小行星轨道的效果极易受其不规则形状的影响，入射角度的微小偏差可能导致防御失败。
snippet: A nuclear explosion might save Earth from a deadly asteroid, but new research suggests that hitting the wrong side could make the difference between success and disaster. Scientists found that an asteroid's irregular shape can dramatically affect how it responds to an X-ray blast, with deflection effectiveness varying nearly fivefold depending on the angle.

title: Ancient Siberian tomb reveals surprising secrets of cannabis use 2,800 years ago
title_zh: 西伯利亚古墓发现2800年前大麻使用证据
summary_zh: 考古学家在西伯利亚一处古代斯基泰人（Scythian）墓穴中发现了大量大麻种子，提供了古人利用大麻致幻特性进行祭祀活动的直接考古证据。
snippet: Scientists investigating a 2,800-year-old Siberian tomb discovered roughly 1,000 cannabis seeds and chemical evidence suggesting ancient Scythians used the plant for its intoxicating effects. The remarkable find, surrounded by evidence of elaborate burial rituals and animal sacrifices, offers the oldest directly dated archaeological evidence of psychoactive cannabis use.

title: Scientists discover hidden brain changes linked to common sleep disorders
title_zh: 常见睡眠障碍可能导致大脑结构性改变
summary_zh: 一项综合分析57项影像学研究的发现显示，睡眠障碍与负责注意力和决策的大脑区域结构变化有关，这解释了睡眠不足为何影响认知功能。
snippet: Scientists have discovered that sleep disorders are associated with structural changes in brain regions that control attention, decision-making, and emotions, potentially explaining why disrupted sleep can affect everyday thinking and behavior. The findings, drawn from 57 brain imaging studies, reveal both shared and disorder-specific patterns that could lead to more targeted treatments.

title: Scientists squeeze record-breaking X-ray power into an incredibly tiny spot
title_zh: 科学家实现超快X射线脉冲技术突破
summary_zh: 研究人员产生了持续时间仅300阿秒（attosecond，即10的负18次方秒）的极强X射线闪光，该技术有望用于观测电子的实时运动并精准控制化学反应。
snippet: Scientists have created record-breaking X-ray flashes lasting just 300 attoseconds, concentrating enormous power into an incredibly tiny spot. The breakthrough could unlock a new way to observe electrons in action and potentially control the ultrafast processes that drive chemical reactions.

title: Stronger flu shot linked to nearly 55% lower Alzheimer's risk
title_zh: 高剂量流感疫苗或能显著降低阿尔茨海默病风险
summary_zh: 一项针对近20万名65岁以上老人的观察性研究发现，接种高剂量流感疫苗的人群比接种标准剂量者，罹患阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease）的风险显著降低了约55%。
snippet: A surprising new study suggests that a stronger flu shot could offer older adults significantly greater protection against Alzheimer's disease. Researchers at UTHealth Houston analyzed nearly 200,000 adults ages 65 and older and found that those who received a high-dose influenza vaccine had a nearly 55% lower risk of developing Alzheimer's, compared with a 40% reduction previously associated with the standard-dose vaccine.

title: Mysterious gas leaks suggest Mars may still be volcanically alive
title_zh: 火星气体泄漏迹象暗示其地质活动尚未终止
summary_zh: 火星表面观测到的异常气体排放和新裂缝表明，火星深处可能仍存在岩浆活动，这增加了发现地下微生物生命存在的可能性。
snippet: Mysterious gas emissions and fresh volcanic fissures suggest that Mars may not be geologically dead after all, with hot magma potentially still active deep underground. The discovery could point to hidden pockets of warmth and chemical energy capable of supporting microbial life beneath the Red Planet’s surface.

title: A hidden limit of space and time could unlock electronics 100,000 times faster
title_zh: 量子时间空间极限或助力实现超高速电子器件
summary_zh: 科学家发现了一个限制电子时空精度的量子极限，通过利用该机制，未来有望研发出比现有技术快数十万倍的电子设备。
snippet: Scientists have discovered a surprising quantum limit that prevents electrons from being tracked with unlimited precision in both space and time. The breakthrough could pave the way for manipulating chemical reactions and developing electronics hundreds of thousands of times faster than today's technology.

title: APOD: 2026 November 8 – Major Fireball Meteor
title_zh: NASA发布火球流星影像
summary_zh: NASA每日天文图（APOD）展示了一颗壮观的火球流星（fireball），即亮度极高的流星现象，为公众科普了此类天体物理事件。
snippet: APOD Science APOD APOD: 2026 November 8 –… Today’s APOD Archive Submissions Index Search Calendar RSS Education About Discuss APOD Astronomy Picture of the Day Discover the cosmos! Each day a different image or photograph of our fascinating universe is featured, along with a brief explanation written by a professional astronomer. Major Fireball Meteor […]

title: Why the tropics lose the most birds when cities expand
title_zh: 城市扩张对热带鸟类多样性的影响
summary_zh: 研究探讨了城市化对生态系统的影响，指出热带地区在城市扩张过程中比其他区域损失了更多的鸟类生物多样性。
snippet: Tropical ecosystems are famous for their teeming, exuberant diversity. In fact, the dramatic increase in biodiversity from the poles to the tropics—known as the latitudinal diversity gradient—is pervasive across branches of the tree of life, and fossil evidence suggests it has existed for millennia.

title: Personalized savings reminders can help boost retirement savings
title_zh: 个性化提醒如何促进退休储蓄
summary_zh: 这项社会科学研究探讨了心理学策略对经济行为的影响，比较了“获得性”与“损失性”提醒对个人参与退休储蓄意愿的不同效果。
snippet: Private retirement savings are an increasingly important topic in public debate. One popular idea is to phrase savings reminders in one of two ways: either you emphasize what someone stands to lose if they don't save, or you emphasize what they stand to gain if they do. To date, research into which of the two reminder messages is more effective in terms of influencing people's efforts to save has produced conflicting results.

title: NASA Awards Moon Base Transportation, Technology, Science Projects
title_zh: NASA推进月球基地建设相关项目
summary_zh: NASA宣布了一系列投资，旨在通过商业机器人送货、核动力月球车（nuclear-powered rover）PROMISE及基础设施建设，实现月球的长期驻留。
snippet: NASA announced a suite of awards and mission updates on Saturday to expand the agency’s Moon Base exploration, science, and infrastructure capabilities. The investments will advance commercial robotic deliveries, a nuclear-powered rover named PROMISE, launch and orbital transfer services, and surface infrastructure as the agency works with American industry to establish a sustained presence on […]

title: Student finds proof of rare wild cat in northern New Mexico
title_zh: 学生在美新墨西哥州发现稀有野生猫科动物踪迹
summary_zh: 一名学生在卡森国家森林（Carson National Forest）利用运动感应摄像机，意外拍摄到了稀有野生猫科动物的影像，为当地生物多样性研究提供了新线索。
snippet: Armed with dozens of motion-sensing cameras, William Grooms spent this past summer documenting wildlife across Carson National Forest in northern New Mexico. It was his first field season collecting photos for a two-year study to understand how forest structure influences biodiversity in the Southern Rocky Mountains.

title: The hidden ways insects support animal life—from habitat to health—go way beyond being food
title_zh: 昆虫在自然界中承担远超食物来源的关键角色
summary_zh: 昆虫不仅是动物的食物，还在维持生态系统服务（ecosystem services）中扮演关键角色，例如传粉和分解废弃物，对地球生态健康至关重要。
snippet: There are at least 14 million insect species on Earth, and they play highly diverse roles in sustaining the natural world. Insects provide many well-known benefits—what scientists often call "ecosystem services." For example, you can thank a bee or a hoverfly for pollinating wildflowers and agricultural crops, or credit dung beetles for decomposing manure and other waste materials.

title: Different text genres help doctoral students adapt their writing to reach new readers
title_zh: 不同文本体裁对博士生写作技能培养的启示
summary_zh: 研究指出，学术摘要、博客文章与科普文的写作要求迥异，博士生需针对不同读者群体和目的进行专门的写作训练，以提升跨领域交流能力。
snippet: An academic abstract, a blog post and a public outreach article all place different demands on the writer. Readers' prior knowledge varies, as does the purpose of the text and what needs explaining. Mastering one kind of text therefore does not automatically mean being able to write another.

title: NASA Seeks Next Generation of Explorers to Join Astronaut Corps
title_zh: NASA公开招募新一代宇航员
summary_zh: NASA正在招募新一批宇航员候选人，为执行未来的月球基地建设及首次载人火星探测任务做准备。
explain_zh: NASA正在开启新一轮宇航员招募，旨在选拔能够参与重返月球、建设月球基地及未来载人火星任务的候选人。申请者需具备美国公民身份，并拥有科学、技术、工程或数学（STEM）领域的硕士学位或同等资质，同时需满足相关专业工作经验或飞行时长要求。此次招募将持续至2026年12月3日，最终选定者将接受包括太空行走、月球地质等在内的专业训练，成为推动人类深空探测任务的关键力量。
snippet: NASA is looking for the explorers who will help write the next chapter of human spaceflight. Applications are now open for the agency’s next class of astronauts, who will join NASA as America returns to the Moon, builds the Moon Base, and lays the groundwork for the first crewed missions to Mars. The next generation […]

title: Two paths, one flux: Trapped ions simulate Aharonov–Bohm interference in a lattice gauge theory
title_zh: 捕获离子系统模拟阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆效应
summary_zh: 研究人员利用混合捕获离子（trapped-ion）量子计算机，在晶格规范理论（lattice gauge theory）的量子模拟中成功验证了阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆效应（Aharonov-Bohm effect），展示了量子模拟在理解基础物理现象中的应用。
snippet: In a new Nature Physics study, researchers demonstrated the Aharonov-Bohm effect in a quantum simulation of a lattice gauge theory using a hybrid trapped-ion quantum computer.

title: Earth's gravity may have kept the early moon's volcanic heart beating
title_zh: 地球引力或曾维持早期月球的火山活动
summary_zh: 针对嫦娥五号（Chang'e-5）带回样本的研究显示，月球火山活动比预期更晚。科学家提出，早期地球的引力潮汐作用可能为月球提供了额外热量，使其火山“心脏”得以多跳动了数十亿年。
explain_zh: 研究发现，约20亿年前月球表面仍存在火山活动，这可能是当时地月距离较近时，地球引力产生的潮汐加热（tidal heating）所致。研究团队通过计算机模拟，结合更真实的月幔（mantle）3D结构发现，月球核幔边界的特定区域能吸收巨大能量并维持高温。这一机制不仅解释了为何早期月球能产生玄武岩，还可能维持了月球早期的磁场，为理解月球地质演化提供了新视角。
snippet: We typically think of the moon as a static, floating object that has remained the same for basically its entire lifetime, with an occasional asteroid impact serving as an exception. That understanding is grounded in physics—the moon should have cooled rapidly after forming when a huge protoplanet hit the early Earth around 4.5 billion years ago. But some lunar material returned from the Chang'e-5 mission was notably formed only around 2 billion years ago, yet appeared to be volcanic in origin.

title: Scientists discover new jellyfish species in waters off Alicante in Spain
title_zh: 地中海发现微型水母新物种
summary_zh: 研究人员在西班牙阿利坎特沿海发现并描述了一种仅几毫米大的新水母物种Copula lucentia。这一发现再次证明，海洋中仍有大量未知的生物多样性等待探索。
snippet: The Mediterranean Sea still holds species unknown to science. One of them is Copula lucentia, a tiny jellyfish measuring just a few millimeters. Discovered off El Campello, in Alicante, it was formally described in 2024 by a research team at the University of Alicante (UA) Marine Laboratory in Dénia, which forms part of the university's Ramón Margalef Multidisciplinary Institute for Environmental Research.

title: Heavy rain can more than double glacier speeds in Alaska
title_zh: 大雨会导致阿拉斯加冰川滑动速度翻倍
summary_zh: 研究发现，强降雨会显著改变冰川的物理状态，使其滑动速度比平时快出数倍。这一现象挑战了传统认知中冰川是缓慢移动的“坚硬冰块”的观点。
snippet: Glaciers are often thought of as unyielding blocks of ice that slowly carve out the landscape as they move downhill by gravity. But sometimes their slow crawl becomes a surge that sees them move orders of magnitude faster than their usual speed.

title: The introduction of a medieval public health system exposed the population to roundworm
title_zh: 中世纪公共卫生干预曾导致寄生虫传播
summary_zh: 历史研究表明，中世纪特隆赫姆尝试改善公共卫生的手段适得其反，反而促进了蛔虫病（roundworm）的传播，揭示了公共卫生政策在实施过程中的复杂性。
snippet: Medieval health and sanitation efforts involved deliberate interventions; however, some of these measures had the opposite effect, leading to an increased spread of disease in Trondheim.

title: Theory predicting an older universe without dark matter or dark energy passes key cosmological tests
title_zh: 宇宙学新理论挑战暗物质与暗能量存在
summary_zh: 一项基于CCC+TL宇宙学模型的研究提出，宇宙年龄可能长达267亿年，且无需引入暗物质或暗能量即可解释宇宙观测数据，该结论通过了多项宇宙学检验。
explain_zh: 研究人员提出了一个名为“协变耦合常数加疲劳光”（CCC+TL）的宇宙学模型，该模型认为宇宙年龄约为267亿年，且无需暗物质或暗能量即可解释观测现象。通过对宇宙微波背景、轻元素丰度及星系旋转曲线等多个关键测试，该模型表现出与现有观测的高度一致性。该研究的局限在于其颠覆了标准宇宙学模型，仍需更多数据（如詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜的进一步观测）来验证其在解释早期超大质量星系方面的预测。
snippet: An alternative model in which the universe is 26.7 billion years old and needs neither dark matter nor dark energy has held up against several major cosmology tests, according to a new University of Ottawa study. The research, titled "A Big Bang Nucleosynthesis Consistency Test of the CCC+TL Cosmology," is published in the journal Universe.

title: Why treating soil acidity crop by crop is no longer enough for prairie farmers
title_zh: 加拿大草原农业需要跨周期土壤酸碱度管理
summary_zh: 研究建议加拿大西部农民应从单一作物视角转向多年度轮作视角来管理土壤酸度。这对于保障未来农业的可持续生产与粮食安全具有重要实践价值。
snippet: To protect their future harvests, Western Canadian farmers need to manage soil acidity across their entire multiyear rotation rather than crop by crop, long-term research from the University of Alberta suggests.

title: The Bantu expansion changed Africa. Scientists are still tracing how.
title_zh: 班图人扩张对非洲历史的深远影响
summary_zh: 科学家正利用基因学和考古学证据，进一步揭示班图语系民族（Bantu speakers）在非洲大陆的迁徙与扩张模式。这项研究有助于重构非洲文明演变的复杂历史。
explain_zh: 科学家通过跨学科合作，结合语言学比较、考古遗存分析及遗传学全基因组研究，勾勒出“班图人迁徙”（Bantu expansion）的复杂历史轨迹。研究确认班图人群体起源于西非，在数千年前向南及向东扩散过程中，将农耕、冶金和陶瓷技术带到了撒哈拉以南非洲。这一迁徙不仅改变了非洲的族群分布与基因结构，也促成了现代非洲大规模语言群体的形成，是人类历史上重要的一次人口迁徙事件。
snippet: Genes and archaeology are revealing how Bantu speakers spread across much of Africa.

title: Diwali celebrations coincide with worsening air. Here's how to stay safer
title_zh: 排灯节期间空气质量恶化与健康防护
summary_zh: 南亚地区（尤其是印度北部）在庆祝排灯节时常伴随着严重的冬季空气污染，研究强调了在此期间采取防护措施以降低呼吸系统健康风险的必要性。
snippet: For people across South Asia, especially in northern India, Diwali celebrations coincide with the return of hazardous winter air, raising concerns about how to celebrate safely.

title: Pakistani astronaut to board Shenzhou 24 and become the first foreigner on China's space station
title_zh: 巴基斯坦宇航员将入驻中国空间站
summary_zh: 据报道，一名巴基斯坦宇航员将参与神舟24号任务，这将使他成为首位进入中国空间站的外国籍宇航员，标志着航天领域国际合作的进一步深入。
snippet: A Pakistani astronaut will join the crew of China's Shenzhou 24 spacecraft on a mission that would make him the first foreign national to board Beijing's space station, state media reported Saturday.

title: Polar vortex faltering weeks earlier than ever recorded
title_zh: 极地涡旋出现史上最早异常减弱
summary_zh: 气象学家观测到极地涡旋（polar vortex）出现了前所未有的早期异常扰动。这一现象可能增加北半球出现寒潮天气的风险，但目前科学界对此仍存在高度不确定性。
snippet: Meteorologists said Friday they were observing an unprecedented early disruption of the polar vortex, raising the risk of cold snaps across the Northern Hemisphere, though there remains significant uncertainty.

title: Scientists discovered an unknown baby right whale off Canada. They say it's a cause for joy
title_zh: 加拿大海岸发现珍稀露脊鲸幼崽
summary_zh: 研究人员在加拿大海域发现了一头此前未知的露脊鲸（right whale）幼崽。这一发现为濒危鲸类的种群恢复带来了新的希望。
snippet: It would seem difficult to miss a 15,000-pound (6,804-kilogram) baby, but for months scientists who study rare whales did just that, and now they couldn't be happier.

title: Atlanta's new giant pandas will make their public debut after a 2-year absence
title_zh: 大熊猫回归亚特兰大动物园
summary_zh: 中断两年后，一对大熊猫即将重返美国亚特兰大动物园并与公众见面，这对于促进公众关注濒危物种保护具有积极意义。
snippet: Panda lovers are expected to line up Friday at Zoo Atlanta to see a new pair of giant pandas make their public debut.

title: Human bodies produce 2 billion metric tons of CO2 a year just by staying alive
title_zh: 人类呼吸产生的二氧化碳对气候模型的影响
summary_zh: 人类每年因生理活动呼出超过20亿吨二氧化碳，这是自然碳循环的一部分。科学家认为，提高对该数据的测量准确性有助于优化现有的气候模型。
snippet: Humans collectively produce more than 2 billion tonnes of carbon dioxide annually just by turning food into energy, a 74% increase over three decades largely driven by population growth. Unlike fossil fuel emissions, however, the CO2 we exhale is part of the natural carbon cycle, and scientists say measuring it more accurately could improve climate models.

title: Scientists discover Europe's ancient forests were nothing like we imagined
title_zh: 欧洲远古生态环境重构挑战现有植树策略
summary_zh: 研究发现欧洲在过去2000万年间以开阔林地和草地为主，而非原先认定的茂密森林。这一发现建议在生物多样性保护中，需谨慎对待人工种植大面积茂密森林的策略。
explain_zh: 研究通过对过去2300万年的古生态记录（包括化石花粉、沉积物DNA及食草动物牙齿化学特征）进行综合分析，发现欧洲历史上长期维持着由疏林、草地和湿地组成的半开放景观，而非此前认为的森林覆盖。该发现指出，大型食草动物的放牧活动是维持这种多样性生境的关键。这挑战了现代“密林造林”的生态保护策略，提示单一植树可能反而损害生物多样性。
snippet: Scientists have uncovered evidence that Europe was dominated for more than 20 million years by open woodlands, colorful meadows, and large grazing animals, not the dense forests long considered its natural state. The surprising discovery challenges modern reforestation strategies, suggesting that planting thick forests could actually harm the biodiversity conservationists hope to protect.

title: Rubin Observatory discovers two hidden companions of the Milky Way. Hundreds more may be waiting
title_zh: 鲁宾天文台发现银河系隐藏的卫星天体
summary_zh: 薇拉·鲁宾天文台（Vera C. Rubin Observatory）利用初步观测数据识别出了银河系未知的卫星天体。这预示着未来深空探测将揭示更多银河系的隐藏结构。
snippet: The Vera C. Rubin Observatory has already uncovered two previously unknown companions of the Milky Way using preliminary observations covering just 7% of the night sky. The discoveries include an extremely faint galaxy 355,000 light-years away and a star cluster hidden behind cosmic dust. Scientists suspect hundreds of additional satellite galaxies remain undiscovered, and Rubin's powerful telescope could finally bring them into view.

title: A dead star's mysterious rings reveal what could happen when our Sun dies
title_zh: 死星周围的双环结构预示太阳系未来
summary_zh: 天文学家在某死亡恒星周围发现了疑似由行星残骸构成的双环结构，其中的缝隙暗示了存在幸存的行星天体。这为了解恒星死亡后的行星系统演化提供了重要线索。
explain_zh: 天文学家利用甚大望远镜（VLT）发现了一颗白矮星（white dwarf）周围存在独特的双环碎片盘，环间空隙可能由幸存的行星体维持。该碎片盘富含钙、镁、氧、铁等元素，且内外环成分不同，暗示它们可能源自不同被毁行星的残骸。这一发现不仅展示了恒星演化末期的极端环境，也为未来太阳系在太阳死亡后的可能命运提供了观测参照。
snippet: Astronomers have discovered a strange double ring of planetary wreckage around a dead star, revealing a possible preview of our Solar System's distant future. The two rings are separated by a mysterious gap that researchers believe is maintained by surviving planetary bodies, including one potentially as large as Pluto or the Moon. Their different chemical compositions suggest they may contain the remains of separate destroyed planets.

title: Scientists accidentally solve a chemistry mystery that lasted 60 years
title_zh: 科研人员破解60年化学难题：稳定硼氧分子
summary_zh: 科学家成功合成了此前被认为极不稳定而难以捕捉的硼氧分子。这项实验突破可能会催生一系列新型奇异化合物，具有极高的基础科研价值。
snippet: After more than 60 years of unsuccessful attempts, scientists have finally isolated stable examples of elusive boron-oxygen molecules once considered too unstable to capture. The surprising breakthrough, achieved using relatively simple chemical reactions, could pave the way for an entirely new class of exotic compounds.

title: APOD: 2026 November 7 – De Gerlache-Kocher Massif
title_zh: 月球南极的地貌特征：De Gerlache-Kocher山块
summary_zh: NASA展示了月球南极地区De Gerlache-Kocher山块的精细影像。该区域因其特殊的光照条件和水冰潜力，是未来月球探测和基地建设的关键目标。
explain_zh: 天文学家通过望远镜捕捉到了月球南极附近De Gerlache-Kocher地块（Massif）的高清图像，该山脉高度约4公里。由于其山顶可获得几乎持续的太阳能，且阴影区可能蕴含水冰，该区域被视为月球首个载人定居点及Artemis计划潜在的着陆点。此次成像利用了月球的天平动（libration，即月球在轨道上的摆动效应），从而获得了这一独特的南极斜视视角。
snippet: APOD Science APOD APOD: 2026 November 7 –… Today’s APOD Archive Submissions Index Search Calendar RSS Education About Discuss APOD Astronomy Picture of the Day Discover the cosmos! Each day a different image or photograph of our fascinating universe is featured, along with a brief explanation written by a professional astronomer. De Gerlache-Kocher Massif […]

title: Disasters and debt. Escaping the 'climate-debt doom loop'
title_zh: 气候灾害与债务：破解“气候-债务恶性循环”
summary_zh: 研究探讨了气候灾害对发展中国家造成的经济压力，特别是灾后重建引发的债务负担。这对于理解全球气候变化带来的社会经济影响具有重要参考意义。
snippet: It took around 480,000 trucks to haul away 4.8 million metric tons (5.3 million tons) of rubble across western Jamaica after Hurricane Melissa tore through the Caribbean in 2025, United Nations satellites showed.

title: Untangling the patterns of the cosmic microwave background to better understand the early universe
title_zh: 解构宇宙微波背景辐射，探索宇宙起源
summary_zh: 科学家通过观测宇宙微波背景辐射（Cosmic Microwave Background, CMB，大爆炸留下的残留热辐射），试图梳理其模式以揭示宇宙早期演化的奥秘。
snippet: A figure in red trudges across a blanket of white. Snow squeaks under the scientist's feet, too dry to be slick or soft. Only a line of flags and a few large buildings—the scientist's destination—break up the landscape. The sun hovers on the horizon, never quite setting against a blue sky devoid of clouds.

title: Spot a baby bird on the ground? Don't be tempted to bird‑nap it
title_zh: 路遇幼鸟请勿盲目救助
summary_zh: 春季是幼鸟学习飞行的季节，如果在地面发现幼鸟，通常不应将其带走，因为这可能会阻碍其正常学习生存技能。
snippet: Spring is the season of blooming flowers and buzzing bees.

title: The wasps that horrified Darwin reveal evolution's one-way streets
title_zh: 达尔文黄蜂：演化中的死亡专家
summary_zh: 研究寄生蜂达尔文黄蜂（Darwin wasps）的生活方式，揭示了自然界中极端演化策略的单一性，即通过寄生宿主并逐步吞噬存活的幼虫生存。
snippet: Few insects have a more gruesome lifestyle than Darwin wasps. Rather than simply hunting other animals, these parasitic wasps lay their eggs on or inside living hosts, including caterpillars, beetles and spiders. Their larvae then feed on their hosts, gradually consuming them and eventually killing them.

title: Air holes turn silicon wafers into flat ultraviolet focusing mirrors for compact optics
title_zh: 微孔结构让硅片化身为紫外超表面透镜
summary_zh: 通过在硅片上蚀刻空气孔，研究者开发出一种平面的紫外（ultraviolet）超表面（metasurface）反射镜。这种技术克服了传统材料吸收紫外光的难题，有望实现更紧凑的高分辨率光学成像系统。
snippet: Traditional lenses and mirrors focus light using curved surfaces. Metasurfaces can achieve similar functions with a flat layer of nanoscale structures that locally control the phase of light. Extending these flat optics into the ultraviolet could support compact systems for high-resolution imaging, spectroscopy, and sensing, but it introduces a fundamental materials problem: many of the materials used to make metasurfaces strongly absorb UV light.

title: How a metabolite protects the enzyme that consumes it
title_zh: 细胞通过反馈机制调节代谢酶
summary_zh: 研究人员揭示了色氨酸代谢中的分子调控机制：通过氨基酸与酶的特定位点结合，酶能实现“自我保护”以避免过度消耗。这一发现阐明了细胞维持代谢平衡的精细策略。
snippet: Metabolites are consumed by enzymes to produce other vital molecules as well as to control metabolite levels. But how do cells avoid consuming too much? Researchers from the MPI of Biochemistry, with the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, and the de Duve Institute in Brussels, have deciphered such molecular regulation in tryptophan metabolism. The essential amino acid tryptophan binds to a second site on the enzyme TDO2, distinct from where it is consumed. This sequesters a region needed by two ef

title: New method measures microplastics in the air using an uncrewed aerial system
title_zh: 无人机系统助力监测大气微塑料
summary_zh: 科研团队开发出一种利用无人机系统（uncrewed aerial system）在大气中采集并测量微塑料的方法，旨在深入研究这些污染物在大气中的移动规律。
snippet: Microplastics have been found in our bodies and the food we eat—and even in remote environments around the world, including seawater and ice in the Arctic. Despite their prevalence, little is known about how they move through the atmosphere. New CIRES-led research, which demonstrates a new method for sampling microplastics in the atmosphere using an uncrewed aerial system (UAS), aims to change that. The findings are published in the journal Scientific Reports.

title: Future warming events will outdo the extreme heat waves of the recent past, new study finds
title_zh: 未来气候变化将引发更严重的极端热浪
summary_zh: 发表在《自然-通讯》的研究表明，随着气候变化，未来的热浪将持续时间更长、影响范围更广且强度更大，过去的极端天气可能仅是未来的预演。
explain_zh: 研究指出，未来全球变暖将导致热浪在持续时间、影响范围及严重程度上显著超过近年纪录。研究者通过对比2010至2023年间的22起极端热浪事件与2020至2100年的气候模型预测，发现这种极端高温在21世纪末可能成为常态。即使采取减排措施，若无积极的适应手段，本世纪后期仍将面临远超近期体验的严酷高温挑战。
snippet: The extreme heat waves we have seen over the last few years may only serve as a preview of what is to come as a result of climate change. A new study led by researcher Philipp Aglas-Leitner from Freie Universität Berlin, published in Nature Communications, finds that future heat waves could last longer, impact larger areas, and be much more severe.

title: Light-powered method resurrects 'dead-end' compounds for drug discovery
title_zh: 光动力法让“死胡同”化合物重获新生
summary_zh: 研究人员开发了一种利用光能量的新方法，可将药物研发中原本被废弃的化合物“重新激活”，为发现新型药物提供了新的研究起点。
snippet: Throughout the drug development process, which can take a decade or more, tens of thousands of chemical compounds are produced that never go on to become medicines. A Florida State University researcher is part of a team that has discovered a new way to give some of these "dead ends" a second chance at becoming the foundation for tomorrow's blockbuster drugs.

title: Earth's churning mantle may have created the Great Unconformity
title_zh: 地球地幔对流或可解释“大不整合”
summary_zh: 科学家提出，地壳下方的地幔（mantle）运动可能导致了“大不整合”（Great Unconformity），即寒武纪沉积层直接覆盖在远古岩石之上的地质现象。这项研究有助于理解地表地质演变的历史。
explain_zh: 研究提出“大不整合面”（Great Unconformity，地球地质记录中长达数亿年的缺失）的形成，是地幔动力学与冰川侵蚀共同作用的结果。研究人员通过地幔对流模拟发现，地幔的热岩流导致大陆地壳发生长期的隆起与下沉，配合“雪球地球”（Snowball Earth）时期的强力冰川刨蚀，清除了地表岩层。该过程不仅解释了这一地质空白，还推测被冲入海洋的岩石碎屑可能为寒武纪生命大爆发提供了钙质养分。
snippet: Explaining the Great Unconformity, where Cambrian deposits sit on top of older rocks.

title: Quantum gas microscope reveals individual atoms in first tunable three-component Hubbard system
title_zh: 量子气体显微镜捕捉三组分哈伯德系统原子行为
summary_zh: 科学家首次在实验室中创建了可调控的三组分哈伯德（Hubbard）系统，并利用量子气体显微镜成功观测到单个原子。这为模拟核物理和材料科学中的量子行为提供了基础。
snippet: For the first time, an international team of researchers from Germany, Thailand, India, China and the United States has created a three-component Hubbard system with tunable interactions in the laboratory. In doing so, the team used a quantum gas microscope to make the individual atoms visible. The study, published in Science, provides an important foundation for future quantum simulations of nuclear physics and materials science.

title: European forests need to solve two crises—but not necessarily in one place
title_zh: 欧洲森林管理需在固碳与生物多样性间寻求平衡
summary_zh: 研究指出，森林既是重要的碳汇（carbon sink，指吸收并储存碳的场所）又是生物栖息地，但这两项功能并不总是能在同一片森林中实现最大化，欧洲林业政策需进行针对性规划。
snippet: Forest areas can act both as carbon sinks and as vital habitats for thousands of species—but not necessarily at the same time. This has important implications for how Europe should manage its forests, says a University of Copenhagen researcher.

title: MTG-I2 satellite delivers remarkable first images, capturing a weather view of Europe every 2.5 minutes
title_zh: MTG-I2卫星交付首批高频气象云图
summary_zh: MTG-I2气象卫星传回首批高分辨率图像，该卫星能每2.5分钟对欧洲进行一次全貌扫描，大幅提升了对突发极端天气的监测与预警能力。
explain_zh: 气象卫星MTG-I2成功传回首批高分辨率地球影像，展示了其每2.5分钟对欧洲及大西洋区域进行一次快速扫描的能力。该卫星通过地球静止轨道观测，能捕捉云层和天气系统的精细动态，不仅能帮助预报员监控快速演变的天气灾害，还能提供更精准的预警。这一功能对于应对暴雨、山火等快速发展的极端天气具有重要意义。
snippet: Europe's meteorological satellite agency, EUMETSAT, has released the first image from the Flexible Combined Imager (FCI) on board Meteosat Third Generation Imager 2 (MTG-I2), just over two months after the satellite's launch on Aug. 27, 2026. The satellite will provide forecasters with high-resolution observations of Europe every 2.5 minutes. This unprecedented frequency will help forecasters monitor fast-developing weather hazards more closely and support earlier, more precise warnings.

title: The John Lewis Christmas ad captures the deep need for grandmothers
title_zh: 从广告看祖母角色的社会价值
summary_zh: 本文讨论了某品牌年度圣诞广告将祖母作为主角的现象，分析了这一角色在家庭与社会中不可替代的情感支撑作用。
snippet: Like many of us, I always enjoy the John Lewis Christmas ad and 2026 is no different. This year, I love the fact that the star of the show is a grandmother.

title: Vibrating mirrors of light create analog of a black hole event horizon
title_zh: 利用光腔模拟黑洞事件视界
summary_zh: 科学家提出通过改变光腔中反射镜的距离，可能在光波中模拟黑洞事件视界（event horizon）附近的物理效应，为验证量子引力理论提供实验途径。
snippet: Optical cavities are pairs of light-trapping mirrors and underpin the operation of lasers, atomic clocks and many types of precision sensors. If the distance between the mirrors is changed rapidly enough, some theories predict that the waves inside them should bunch together into short, intense pulses. So far, however, this prediction has never been tested directly.

title: Atom-scale model could help improve material growth for advanced electronics
title_zh: 优化原子尺度模型以提升半导体材料生长
summary_zh: 研究人员通过精细化碳化硅（silicon carbide）晶体生长过程的原子尺度模型，旨在帮助制造业减少试错成本，提高先进制程电子材料的质量。
snippet: Penn State researchers have refined an atom-scale model of how silicon carbide changes from a solid into vapor during crystal growth, work that could help manufacturers produce higher-quality material for advanced electronics while reducing costly trial-and-error experiments.

title: States tax sports betting heavily, but gamblers may barely feel it
title_zh: 美国体育博彩税收现状分析
summary_zh: 探讨了美国博彩市场合法化以来的规模增长及税收政策，指出尽管政府征收重税，但由于税负转嫁机制，个人赌客对实际税负的感知并不明显。
snippet: Sports betting has grown explosively since 2018, when a U.S. Supreme Court ruling struck down a federal ban on it. Now, Americans wager more than $165 billion on sports annually, contributing to an industry larger than state-run lotteries even excluding prediction markets such as Kalshi and Polymarket.

title: Evolutionary history and genetic basis of spruce diversification revealed
title_zh: 揭示云杉属植物的演化与多样化史
summary_zh: 研究通过解决长期存在的基因信号冲突问题，理清了广泛分布于北半球的云杉属（Picea）植物的系统发育关系和进化历程。
snippet: The genus Picea (spruce) is widely distributed across the Northern Hemisphere and is a dominant component of boreal and montane forests. Understanding the evolutionary processes that have shaped diversification and regional differentiation across the genus requires a well-resolved phylogeny of Picea. However, the evolutionary history of Picea has long been obscure due to conflicting genetic signals.

title: Scientists achieve record-breaking low temperature on China's space station, paving the way for new physics experiments
title_zh: 中国空间站创下极低温记录
summary_zh: 中国空间站近期实现了创纪录的超低温环境，这一成果将为在微重力下研究量子物理及探索物质新状态提供关键实验平台。
snippet: Matter starts to behave differently at extremely low temperatures, creating conditions ideal for studying quantum physics and new states of matter. Now, researchers from China have achieved a new low-temperature record aboard their Tiangong space station. Their research, recently published in Science, might lead to a new generation of experiments in quantum physics and precision measurements in space.

title: Technique that spots tRNAs in action could accelerate drug development for inherited diseases
title_zh: 新型tRNA动态监测技术助力遗传病药物研发
summary_zh: 研究人员开发了一种监测转移核糖核酸（tRNA）运作的新技术，有助于深入理解蛋白质合成过程，并为针对遗传疾病的药物研发提供靶点。
snippet: Human cells turn genetic instructions into proteins with great precision. Critical for the translation of this information are transfer RNAs, or tRNAs, small molecules that read the genetic code three letters at a time and bring the matching building blocks of proteins, the amino acids, to the cell's protein-making machinery, the ribosome.

title: Researchers establish G0 founder population carrying targeted mutations in marine mollusks
title_zh: 海洋软体动物基因编辑育种获突破
summary_zh: 研究团队成功培育出经过基因编辑的海洋软体动物后代，克服了幼体变态发育的难关，为水产育种技术的改良奠定了基础。
snippet: Although genome-editing-based breeding has advanced rapidly in aquaculture, progress in marine mollusks has lagged behind. The main challenge is not genome editing itself, but rather rearing the few edited larvae through metamorphosis to establish a viable G0 founder population.

title: M30’s Sparkling Stars
title_zh: 哈勃望远镜拍摄球状星团M30
summary_zh: NASA发布了哈勃望远镜拍摄的球状星团M30影像。该星团是天文学家查尔斯·梅西耶早期编制天体目录时的观测目标，展现了银河系演化的历史遗迹。
snippet: This NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope image released Nov. 5, 2026, provides a lesson in galactic history. The sparkling collection of stars is named Messier 30 (M30) after the French astronomer, Charles Messier, who cataloged M30 and other diffuse objects that might be mistaken for comets in the early telescopes of Messier’s time. M30 lies about […]

title: Robot successfully builds space structure in first autonomous construction demo
title_zh: 机器人首次自主完成太空结构建造
summary_zh: 加州理工学院研发的机器人桁架建造系统成功在太空中自主组装结构，标志着无人空间基础设施制造技术迈出重要一步。
snippet: A robotic truss builder that was conceived, designed and built by Caltech researchers has successfully built a structure in space—without the help of astronauts—for the first time. The truss builder, part of DARPA's Novel Orbital and Moon Manufacturing, Materials, and Mass-efficient Design (NOM4D) program, consists of an autonomous manipulator that picks up struts and joints held in nearby dispensers to repeatedly assemble identical sections, or bays, of a perimeter truss.

title: New method for upcycling polyethylene is suitable for mass production as a raw material for nylon
title_zh: 塑料废弃物高效转化为尼龙原材料
summary_zh: 德国化学家提出了一种将聚乙烯（polyethylene）塑料转化为二元羧酸的方法，为利用废旧塑料规模化合成尼龙（尼龙，polyamide）提供了可持续的工业路径。
snippet: It would greatly benefit the environment and climate if nylon—chemically known as polyamide—could be produced on a large scale from plastic waste in the future, rather than from petroleum, as has been the norm until now. At LIKAT in Rostock, chemists pursuing this approach have succeeded in selectively converting polyethylene—the main component of all plastic waste—into dicarboxylic acids, which can serve as chemical precursors for nylon.

title: Supercomputing Tech Demo Schedule

summary_zh: NASA在超级计算会议上展示了包括Fortran语言新模板等在内的技术进展，旨在推动科学计算的高效与可靠性。

title: This may be the best evidence yet that dinosaur blood can fossilize
title_zh: 1.15亿年前恐龙化石中发现疑似血细胞
summary_zh: 研究人员通过成像与化学分析，在恐龙化石中发现了疑似血细胞的结构。这一发现若属实，将为了解恐龙生理特征提供新视角，但学术界对此仍存争议。
snippet: Imaging and chemical analysis of a 115-million-year-old dinosaur fossil points to blood cells. But some aren't convinced.

title: A Strange Quantum Theorem Has Killed Einstein’s Reality
title_zh: 量子定理再次挑战爱因斯坦的现实观
summary_zh: 量子力学中的一项新定理对爱因斯坦坚持的经典物理实在论提出了严峻挑战，进一步揭示了微观世界的诡异特性。
explain_zh: PBR定理（以研究者Pusey、Barrett和Rudolph命名）通过数学论证，否定了将量子态视为某种隐藏现实的描述方式，对爱因斯坦坚持的客观现实观构成了打击。量子力学指出量子态反映了概率而非确定的物理属性，而PBR定理进一步在理论上排除了量子态仅代表我们对客观现实“信息不足”的可能性。这表明量子力学的数学框架与我们日常理解的“事物拥有独立属性”的现实观难以并存，深刻挑战了经典物理的直觉。
snippet: Albert Einstein fought to save our everyday notion of reality from the strangeness of quantum mechanics. But those who set out to aid him keep poking holes in his argument. The post A Strange Quantum Theorem Has Killed Einstein’s Reality first appeared on Quanta Magazine

title: How foreign investment can strengthen African governments' control over land
title_zh: 外资如何加强撒哈拉以南非洲国家的土地管控
summary_zh: 研究发现，撒哈拉以南非洲多国政府正通过外国投资、基建项目和环保计划等手段，加强对土地及社区的行政控制能力。
snippet: African governments are using foreign investment, infrastructure projects and conservation schemes to extend their control over land and communities, according to new research spanning 14 countries in sub-Saharan Africa.

title: Microplastic pollution could be changing the color of the Pacific Ocean
title_zh: 微塑料污染或正改变太平洋颜色
summary_zh: 研究指出，“大太平洋垃圾带”（Great Pacific Garbage Patch）等海域积聚的大量塑料污染，可能正在通过改变光线反射方式影响海洋表面的外观色彩。
snippet: Our oceans have effectively become trash dumps where massive quantities of plastic end up. So much so, in fact, that the largest offshore plastic accumulation zone has been labeled the Great Pacific Garbage Patch.

title: Mineral-forming method removes more than 99% of radioactive technetium from liquid waste
title_zh: 新型矿化技术可清除液体废物中99%以上的放射性锝
summary_zh: 科学家开发出一种通过矿化（mineral-forming）方法处理放射性废物的新技术，能高效去除核工业遗留的主要污染物锝-99（technetium-99）。
snippet: Technetium-99 is a long-lived radioactive byproduct of nuclear fuel production and reprocessing. In many environments, it forms a highly mobile chemical species that can move readily through water and soil, making it a priority contaminant at legacy nuclear sites including Sellafield in the U.K. and Hanford in the United States.

title: The spring mountain butterfly has been spotted for the first time beneath power lines
title_zh: 电力传输线下首次发现濒危春山蝶
summary_zh: 研究人员在西班牙的电力输送线下，首次监测到濒临灭绝的春山蝶（Erebia epistygne），显示出电力基础设施对生物多样性的潜在庇护作用。
snippet: The Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona (UAB) for the first time has detected the presence of the spring mountain butterfly (Erebia epistygne), a species under threat of extinction in Catalonia, under the electricity transmission lines of Red Eléctrica, Spain's transmission system operator.

title: Beyond green claims: Understanding how consumers evaluate sustainable products
title_zh: 消费者如何评估可持续产品？
summary_zh: 研究探讨了消费者对环境可持续性（sustainability）标签的反应，指出罗列过多的环保卖点并不总是能提升消费者的购买评价。
snippet: Sustainability has become an increasingly visible feature of consumer-packaged goods (CPGs), from the ingredients used in household products to the materials and design of their packaging. For companies marketing sustainable products, however, an important question remains: Does communicating more environmental benefits necessarily improve how consumers evaluate a product? Although highlighting several sustainability features may provide a more complete picture, consumers may not respond to all

title: From chaos to 'intelligent' soft matter—how tiny chemical differences guide droplets into ordered structures
title_zh: 微小化学差异如何引导液滴形成有序结构
summary_zh: 研究发现，通过极其微小的化学梯度调节，可以将混沌无序的液滴运动转化为高度协调的有序结构，展示了软物质（soft matter）的智能演化逻辑。
snippet: Disorder can make sense, and understanding its logic can be genuinely useful. A study by a research group at the University of Trento shows how a minimal chemical difference can turn chaotic, disordered motion into a highly coordinated and reproducible structure.

title: Release of largest dataset to date on wildlife in Europe
title_zh: 欧洲发布史上规模最大的野生动物数据集
summary_zh: 由志愿者参与的“Snapshot Europe”项目汇总了欧洲20多个国家使用自动触发相机拍摄的数据，是目前针对全大陆哺乳动物和鸟类的最大规模开放数据库。
snippet: Every autumn for the last five years, hundreds of volunteers have set out remotely triggered cameras in mountains, forests, farms and beaches in more than 20 countries in Europe. Their joint project is called Snapshot Europe, and it's the largest open-access survey of mammals and birds across an entire continent.

title: This armored amphibian once lived and hunted on the seafloor
title_zh: 首次发现完全适应海底生活的两栖动物
summary_zh: 科学家确认生活在约2.37亿年前的 Gerrothorax maritimus 是首个已知不依赖陆地或淡水的两栖动物，这对理解早期脊椎动物演化具有重要意义。
explain_zh: 科学家证实了一种名为Gerrothorax maritimus的古代两栖动物曾完全生活在海水中，这是目前已知唯一适应海洋环境而非陆地或淡水的两栖动物。通过分析化石中锶（strontium）元素的化学特征，研究确认其长期以海产为食并饮用海水。该物种通过体表骨质铠甲防止水分流失，并保留了鳃部结构以适应深海捕食，挑战了传统观念中两栖动物无法长期耐受盐分环境的看法。
snippet: Gerrothorax maritimus , which existed about 237 million years ago, is the first ever amphibian known to have lived without access to land or freshwater.

title: Wacky magnetic fields of ice giants may stem from conductivity changes in their deep interiors
title_zh: 冰巨星磁场异常或源于深部内部导电性变化
summary_zh: 科学家推测，天王星和海王星内部物质导电性随深度的复杂变化，是导致其磁场结构异常混乱的主要原因。
snippet: When NASA's Voyager 2 robotic probe flew by Uranus and Neptune in the 1980s, it uncovered an anomaly: their magnetic fields are highly disordered, unlike Earth's, which has well-defined north and south poles.

title: Why bandicoots and bilbies evolved such different snouts
title_zh: 袋狸与兔袋狸演化出不同吻部结构的原因
summary_zh: 演化生物学研究指出，袋狸（bandicoot）与兔袋狸（bilby）吻部结构的显著差异，是数百万年来适应不同地理环境的结果。
snippet: Why does a quenda have a short, sturdy snout, while its relative the bilby has such a remarkably long one? New research led by Murdoch University's Harry Butler Institute suggests millions of years of adaptation to different environments across Australia and New Guinea may help explain the difference.

title: Paired but out of step: Why electron pairing alone is not enough for room-temperature superconductivity
title_zh: 电子配对不足以实现室温超导
summary_zh: 科学家在《Science》发表研究指出，仅有电子配对（electron pairing）并不足以实现超导（superconductivity），理解这一机制对于开发室温超导体至关重要。
snippet: Levitating trains, ultra-efficient energy storage, and quantum computers: superconductivity could unlock a wealth of possibilities for the future. New research led by scientists from Utrecht, Leiden, and Munich has now shed light on one of the key requirements for achieving superconductivity at room temperature. Their findings, published in Science, bring scientists a step closer to understanding how this might be achieved.

title: Rocket Report: Artemis II literally tore through the atmosphere; New Glenn delay
title_zh: 商业航天动态：Artemis II 任务及日本 Zero 火箭进展
summary_zh: 报道了NASA Artemis II任务测试进展及日本 Interstellar Technologies 公司为其 Zero 火箭获得政府资助的消息。
snippet: Interstellar Technologies announces more government funding for the Japanese Zero rocket.

title: Scientists just found dinosaur blood that survived 115 million years
title_zh: 科学家发现1.15亿年前的恐龙血迹
summary_zh: 研究在1.15亿年前的恐龙骨骼中发现了化学确认的血液残留，挑战了生物大分子保存期限的传统认知，为研究恐龙生理机能提供了新视角。
explain_zh: 科学家在1.15亿年前的恐龙骨骼化石中发现了血红素（heme）等血液分子残留，证实了古代生物分子能长期保存。研究团队通过化学分析检测了Aratasaurus museunacionali化石中的红细胞结构，并发现矿物质黑锰矿（hausmannite）在低氧、多微生物的环境中起到了关键的保护作用。这项发现打破了生物大分子无法在漫长地质年代中保存的假设，为研究古生物生理特征及寻找外星古生命提供了新视角。
snippet: Scientists have discovered chemically confirmed traces of ancient blood inside 115-million-year-old dinosaur bones, challenging assumptions about how long biological molecules can survive. The extraordinary preservation could unlock new clues about dinosaur physiology and even help scientists search for ancient life elsewhere in the universe.

title: Five-inch-long beetle larvae are quietly destroying blueberry roots
title_zh: 基因分析破解蓝莓根部毁坏之谜
summary_zh: 研究人员通过DNA分析确认，长期危害北卡罗来纳州蓝莓种植的“元凶”是一种体长可达5英寸的巨型甲虫幼虫。
snippet: Scientists have solved a mystery surrounding destructive beetles attacking blueberry bushes in North Carolina, identifying a species whose massive larvae can grow up to five inches long and destroy plant roots. Although farmers have reported damage for more than a decade, the insects responsible remained unidentified until researchers used DNA analysis to uncover the culprit.

title: Don't miss: Meteor showers, fireballs, and a supermoon light up November's night sky
title_zh: 11月天象预报与 Voyager 1 航天里程碑
summary_zh: 介绍了11月的流星雨、火星与木星连珠及超级月亮等天文景观，并提及 Voyager 1 探测器飞行距离达到距离地球1个“光天”的里程碑。
snippet: November's night sky is packed with celestial wonders, from bright meteor fireballs and a close pairing of Mars and Jupiter to a spectacular supermoon. Meanwhile, NASA's Voyager 1 is making history by becoming the first spacecraft to reach a distance of one light-day from Earth.

title: NASA’s Swift telescope falls to Earth after nearly 22 years in space
title_zh: NASA Swift 空间望远镜服役22年后陨落
summary_zh: 设计寿命仅两年的 Swift 空间望远镜在轨运行22年后陨落大气层，该项目在观测黑洞与超新星爆发方面做出了里程碑式贡献。
snippet: After nearly 22 years of exploring the universe’s most violent explosions, NASA’s Swift Observatory has re-entered Earth’s atmosphere over Indonesia. Originally designed to last just two years, the pioneering space telescope transformed our understanding of black holes, exploding stars, and mysterious cosmic outbursts.

title: Dead stars could break one of physics' most famous limits
title_zh: 死星或能突破物理学著名质量极限
summary_zh: 计算机模拟显示，白矮星（white dwarf）在强大磁场作用下，其质量可能远超此前公认的物理极限，有助于解释超亮超新星的形成机制。
explain_zh: 研究发现白矮星（white dwarf）内部强大的磁场可能使其突破传统的钱德拉塞卡极限（Chandrasekhar limit，约为1.4倍太阳质量），质量可高达太阳的2.4倍。研究者通过计算机模拟恒星演化过程，发现伴星物质积聚过程中磁场压缩产生的压力能够抵御重力坍缩。这一发现有助于解释天文学中观测到的超亮Ia型超新星现象，并可能修正现有的宇宙距离测量标准。
snippet: A surprising new discovery suggests that some dead stars can grow far more massive than scientists once thought possible. Computer simulations show that powerful magnetic fields could allow white dwarfs to reach 2.4 times the mass of the Sun, dramatically exceeding a famous limit that has stood for decades. The findings could help explain unusually bright supernova explosions that have long puzzled astronomers.

title: An anti-aging drug may help protect the brain before Alzheimer's symptoms begin
title_zh: 抗衰老药物或可预防阿尔茨海默病前期症状
summary_zh: 一项针对携带APOE4高危基因变异人群的小样本研究显示，服用低剂量雷帕霉素（rapamycin）可能改善大脑血流量，有望在认知功能受损前起到预防作用。
snippet: A surprising new study suggests that an anti-aging drug could help protect people genetically predisposed to Alzheimer's disease. Researchers found that just four weeks of low-dose rapamycin improved brain blood flow in healthy middle-aged adults carrying the high-risk APOE4 gene variant, with women showing the strongest benefits. Because declining blood flow can occur years before Alzheimer's symptoms appear, the discovery raises hopes for preventing or delaying the disease before memory loss b

title: Bear necessities: Indian techie builds wildlife alert
title_zh: 印度工程师开发野生动物预警系统
summary_zh: 为减少人与野生动物冲突，一位印度软件工程师开发了在线预警系统，旨在帮助喜马拉雅山区的居民避开危险的野生动物活动区域。
snippet: After his mother was killed in a bear attack in Kashmir, Indian software engineer Mudasir Ali developed an online early-warning system to help people in the Himalayan region avoid dangerous encounters with wildlife.

title: APOD: 2026 November 6 – A Farewell to Swift
title_zh: 每日天文一图：告别斯威夫特卫星
summary_zh: 这是每日天文一图（APOD）对斯威夫特卫星（Swift）的致敬，纪念这台在宇宙高能物理探测领域做出重要贡献的空间观测站。
snippet: APOD Science APOD APOD: 2026 November 6 – A… Today’s APOD Archive Submissions Index Search Calendar RSS Education About Discuss APOD Astronomy Picture of the Day Discover the cosmos! Each day a different image or photograph of our fascinating universe is featured, along with a brief explanation written by a professional astronomer. A Farewell […]

title: Taking a Gander at Utah’s Goosenecks
title_zh: 俯瞰犹他州的鹅颈湾曲流
summary_zh: 圣胡安河在沙漠地貌中雕琢出了深邃且极为弯曲的河道，为地质景观研究提供了壮观的样本。
snippet: The San Juan River has carved deep, improbably curvy meanders into the desert landscape.

title: Investigation links Australian deforestation to beef farming and major bank loans
title_zh: 澳大利亚森林砍伐与牛肉生产及银行贷款的关联调查
summary_zh: 调查显示澳大利亚的森林砍伐问题与牛肉工业及大规模银行贷款密切相关，呼吁关注经济活动对环境的破坏。
snippet: ACF's latest report, "Bulldozers and Broken Promises," an investigation into deforestation, has ruffled a few feathers. But someone has to do it. Why? Because deforestation is a huge problem in Australia.

title: Adaptation isn't keeping up with global warming, UN warns
title_zh: 联合国警告：全球变暖下的适应能力滞后
summary_zh: 联合国环境规划署（UNEP）报告指出，随着全球升温超过1.5°C，资金投入不足和制度壁垒导致应对气候变化的适应措施进展缓慢。
snippet: With global warming set to exceed 1.5°C, adaptation finance falls far short of needs, implementation is constrained by institutional barriers, and losses and damages are mounting, according to a new report from the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP).

title: New species of sawfly described
title_zh: 科罗拉多州发现锯蝇新物种化石
summary_zh: 研究人员在科罗拉多州拥有5000万年历史的绿河组（Green River Formation）地层中，鉴定出了一种新的锯蝇（sawfly）物种。
snippet: Yale College junior Leah Mock did fieldwork in a remote quarry in western Colorado that exposes the 50-million-year-old Green River Formation.

title: How mitochondria keep protein production moving
title_zh: 线粒体如何维持蛋白质的顺利合成
summary_zh: 研究发现一种名为TACO1的蛋白质能帮助线粒体克服合成过程中的序列难题，这一机制的发现为理解相关线粒体疾病提供了线索。
snippet: Researchers at Karolinska Institutet have discovered how a protein called TACO1 helps mitochondria produce proteins when the process encounters difficult sequences. The study, published in Nature Communications, provides new insights into a mechanism that is disrupted in some mitochondrial diseases.

title: Research seeks to clarify assisted suicide practices in Germany and inform future regulation
title_zh: 德国协助自杀实践的研究与监管现状
summary_zh: 研究人员正通过科学数据整理德国协助自杀的实际案例，旨在为未来完善相关法律法规提供客观依据。
snippet: Assisted suicide is morally and ethically controversial. Public debate on the topic tends to arise primarily when a high-profile case comes to light—as was most recently the case with the famous twins Alice and Ellen Kessler. While assisted suicide is permitted in Germany, it is scarcely regulated by law. Until now, there has been little scientifically validated data on the current practice of assisted suicide.

title: Can engineering solve the forever chemical problem?
title_zh: 工程学能解决“永久性化学物质”问题吗？
summary_zh: 科学家正探索利用环糊精聚合物等新技术手段，应对环境中的“永久性化学物质”（PFAS）污染挑战。
snippet: Among the technical inquiries spanning topics like cyclodextrin polymers and mass spectrometry that were stacked in Damian Helbling's inbox was a question about four golden retrievers.

title: Hidden ecological risk from overlooked invasive crayfish species
title_zh: 被忽视的入侵物种：窄螯螯虾的生态风险
summary_zh: 一项研究揭示，在英国被忽视的窄螯螯虾（narrow-clawed crayfish）具有极强的侵略性，其生态风险堪比知名的入侵品种信号螯虾。
snippet: A new study reveals narrow-clawed crayfish, an understudied invasive species in the U.K., to be as aggressive as the well-known signal crayfish.

title: Successful restoration of fish migration requires more than fish passes
title_zh: 鱼道建设不足以完全恢复鱼类洄游
summary_zh: 研究指出，仅建设鱼道（fish passes）不足以实现有效的生态修复，科学的河流维护和水资源管理同样至关重要。
snippet: The Netherlands is constructing fish passes to make rivers and streams accessible to fish again. But how effective are these structures? New Ph.D. research by Panos Panagiotopoulos of Wageningen University shows that successful fish migration requires more than making individual barriers passable. Maintenance and water management are also crucial.

title: Soccer: Opaque club ownership is more likely associated with higher financial and criminal risks
title_zh: 足球俱乐部不透明所有权与金融犯罪风险的关联
summary_zh: 通过分析意大利足球俱乐部的股权结构，研究指出复杂的跨国所有权结构往往与更高的金融风险及犯罪活动关联度更高。
snippet: Who are the ultimate owners of Italian soccer clubs? Where does the money invested in these clubs come from? And what risks lie behind investment funds, fiduciary companies and transnational corporate structures that make it difficult to identify the individuals who ultimately control them?

title: Software squeezes more data out of Webb Telescope for imaging exoplanets
title_zh: 新型软件助力韦布空间望远镜提升系外行星成像能力
summary_zh: 通过优化韦布空间望远镜（Webb Telescope）的物理模型，新开发的处理软件能有效减少干扰噪声，从而从观测数据中提取更多行星图像细节。
explain_zh: 研究人员开发了一种名为FLIP的软件，通过优化物理模型成功提升了James Webb Space Telescope（詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜）拍摄系外行星图像的清晰度。团队利用基于梯度的机器学习优化算法，对望远镜NIRCam相机的百万级参数进行精细调节，从而更准确地建模由于硬件偏差产生的点扩散函数（point spread function）。该技术在针对已知系外行星及变星的观测中，显著提高了信噪比，甚至能在数据中捕捉到此前未发现的行星特征，为探测更暗、更古老的行星提供了新途径。
snippet: Software optimizes a physical model of the telescope to reduce noise.

title: Goodbye, eggshell: How pregnancy emerged in the animal world
title_zh: 告别蛋壳：动物如何演化出胎生
summary_zh: 哺乳动物只经历过一次胎生演化，而蜥蜴和蛇却多次演化出这种特征。科学家正在探索这一深刻演变背后的生理机制和演化驱动因素。
snippet: Mammals evolved live birth just once; lizards and snakes did it over and over. What set the stage for this drastic change and how was it orchestrated?

title: As Antarctic blue whales advance along the road to recovery, continued oversight is key
title_zh: 南极蓝鲸种群数量显著回升
summary_zh: 经过50年的保护，南极蓝鲸种群数量从1973年捕鲸停止后的418头增长至约4018头，研究强调持续监管对物种恢复至关重要。
explain_zh: 研究发现，在长达50年的捕鲸禁令保护下，南极蓝鲸（Antarctic blue whale）种群数量正缓慢回升，目前估计约为4018头。研究者通过整合历史捕鲸数据、现有的样线调查（line transect survey）计数以及光线识别等多源数据，构建模型推算出这一结果。尽管种群处于恢复期，但数量仍远低于捕鲸前的水平，且其作为“生态系统工程师（ecosystem engineers）”在碳封存和养分循环中的作用尚需进一步监测以应对未来环境挑战。
snippet: Antarctic blue whales appear to be creeping back from the brink of extinction after 50 years of protection. A new study estimates the total population at 4,018, up from 418 after the last reported whale catch in 1973.

title: How octopuses squeeze through tiny openings, step by step
title_zh: 章鱼如何穿过狭小孔洞
summary_zh: 研究人员分析了章鱼穿过细小孔洞时的动作序列，这些发现可能为软体机器人（soft robots）的形态设计提供灵感。
explain_zh: 研究揭示了章鱼通过狭窄孔洞的挤压策略，并发现其逃生方案因孔洞大小而异。研究者观察了普通章鱼（Octopus vulgaris）和玛雅章鱼（Octopus maya）在不同尺寸亚克力箱中的行为，通过测量其头骨周围最坚硬的软骨结构尺寸，评估其通过能力。该研究不仅明确了章鱼逃生的步骤，还为软体机器人设计提供了灵感，即如何通过改变形态适应复杂环境。
snippet: In the lab, octopuses used specific moves to slip arms and a bulbous body through tiny holes. The finding could inspire new body plans for soft robots.

title: How octopuses squeeze through too-small gaps
title_zh: 章鱼如何穿过极其狭窄的缝隙
summary_zh: 章鱼凭借身体的极高柔韧性，能通过改变形体像液体一样流过狭小缝隙，从而克服体型大小对其栖息范围的限制。
snippet: Octopuses are extraordinarily versatile. From walking across the seabed on their eight arms to jetting through the water, manipulating tools and squeezing through unimaginably tight spaces, the flexibility of octopuses almost defies belief. "Octopuses can change their body shape to squeeze through tiny holes, almost like water flowing through a gap, so their size doesn't always limit where they can go," says Wenci Xin from the National University of Singapore.

title: Born to be queen: A look inside fire ant hierarchy
title_zh: 火蚁等级制度的遗传机制
summary_zh: 研究发现，一组特定的基因可能为火蚁个体提供优势，使其更有机会生长发育成为蜂后级别的个体。
snippet: A group of genes may give some fire ants an advantage, increasing their chances of growing larger and potentially becoming queens, according to a new study from the University of Georgia.

title: How private schools segregate students by class and strengthen social divisions
title_zh: 私立学校如何加剧阶级隔离
summary_zh: 本文以伦敦Southwark区为例，分析了私立学校如何通过社会阶层筛选，进一步固化社会分化和不平等。
snippet: If you want to see how private schools in the U.K. can reinforce segregation between children of different social classes, the London Borough of Southwark provides a good example.

title: Avian influenza spread beyond a backyard coop on an Illinois farm, analysis finds
title_zh: 高致病性禽流感在农场跨物种传播
summary_zh: 一项分析显示，伊利诺伊州农场暴发的禽流感不仅影响了家禽，还传染给了农场里的家猫和野生老鼠，预警了病原体的跨物种风险。
snippet: An outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza virus that nearly wiped out an Illinois farmer's backyard flock also spread to a domestic cat and wild rats on the farm, an analysis of the animals by the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign Veterinary Diagnostic Laboratory and the University of Missouri Veterinary Medical Diagnostic Laboratory found.

title: Newly identified protein mechanism helps explain how cells respond to physical forces
title_zh: Talin蛋白力学感知机制新发现
summary_zh: 研究发现了一种新的力学调控机制，即关键蛋白Talin如何响应外界机械力变化，从而调节细胞的粘附与力学感知。
snippet: A newly published study is changing our understanding of how the protein talin functions at sites where cells attach to their surroundings. The findings uncover a previously unknown mechanism by which mechanical force regulates talin, a key protein controlling cell adhesion and mechanosensing. The paper is published in the journal Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences.

title: Clothes on the bed, nothing feels right: The psychology behind your seasonal wardrobe meltdown
title_zh: 季节性更替引发的心理与穿搭烦恼
summary_zh: 心理学分析探讨了为何季节变化时，我们面对衣橱会产生认知偏差和心理不适，这是环境改变引起心理适应压力的表现。
snippet: The clocks have gone back, and suddenly getting dressed feels more difficult. The coat you wore constantly last winter is still hanging in the closet, but it no longer looks quite how you remember. The boots you loved in February don't seem to go with anything, while a sweater that once felt like you somehow doesn't anymore.

title: New microscopy method reveals tiny cell structures and their molecular surroundings
title_zh: 新型显微成像技术可视化细胞超微结构
summary_zh: 研究人员开发了一种能在观测微小细胞结构的同时，实时分析其分子环境变化的新型显微镜技术，有助于提升对药物作用机制的研究精度。
snippet: How do cells respond to drugs? A new microscopy technique could provide more precise answers to this question in the future. Researchers from Bielefeld University and the University of Vienna have developed a method as part of the European CHEM-SCAN project that makes the smallest cellular structures visible while also showing how their molecular environment changes.

title: Hubble learns galactic history from stars
title_zh: 哈勃望远镜揭示Messier 30球状星团历史
summary_zh: 通过哈勃望远镜拍摄的影像，天文学家得以观测距离27500光年外的Messier 30星团，揭示了该星团内部恒星演化的历史片段。
snippet: This NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope image provides a lesson in galactic history. The sparkling collection of stars is named Messier 30 (M30) after the French astronomer Charles Messier, who cataloged M30 and other diffuse objects that might be mistaken for comets in the early telescopes of Messier's time. M30 lies about 27,500 light-years away in the constellation Capricornus.

title: Linguist to record the magic songs of the Awajún people of Peru
title_zh: 秘鲁Awajún族“魔法之歌”的语言学记录
summary_zh: 语言学家正在记录秘鲁亚马逊地区Awajún原住民的传统歌谣，旨在研究这些特殊文化载体背后蕴含的文化与语言魅力。
snippet: There is magic in the traditional songs of the Awajún, an Indigenous people of northern Peruvian Amazonia. Otago linguist Dr. Simon Overall has been visiting this area for over 20 years and explains what gives these songs their powers.

title: Record-low temperature created on China’s space station
title_zh: 中国空间站创造超低温纪录
summary_zh: 利用微重力环境，中国空间站内的原子冷却至约10万亿分之一开尔文，达到极低温度水平。
explain_zh: 科学家在中国天宫空间站上利用激光陷阱捕获并冷却了2万个铷原子，成功创造了约10皮开尔文（picokelvin）的极低温纪录。研究者利用微重力环境减少引力对原子云的影响，使其形成玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（Bose-Einstein condensate），这是一种原子达到统一量子态的特殊物质形式。该实验不仅刷新了温度纪录，还为研究奇异物质态、基础物理概念（如等效原理）提供了理想平台。
snippet: With gravity's effects mitigated, atoms orbiting Earth on China’s space station reached about 10 trillionths of a kelvin.

title: Statehouse wins give Democrats new power to push clean energy
title_zh: 美国州议会能源政策走向
summary_zh: 美国民主党在州议会取得的新进展，或将改变该地区推行清洁能源政策的能力。
snippet: Democrats erased the GOP’s trifecta edge and gained new power over energy policy.

title: Midwestern City Lights
title_zh: 从空间站俯瞰美国城市夜景
summary_zh: 国际空间站拍摄的照片记录了黎明前美国东部及中西部地区城市灯火辉煌的景观。
snippet: City lights from the Midwestern United States to the East Coast sparkle across the landscape a couple of hours before sunrise on Oct. 18, 2026. Major urban areas visible in the photograph include Chicago, Illinois; Detroit, Michigan; and the New York metropolitan region. The International Space Station was orbiting 259 miles above Earth when this […]

title: NASA Astronauts to Answer Questions from Florida Students
title_zh: 航天员与学生连线互动
summary_zh: 美国航天员将在国际空间站通过视频连线回答佛罗里达州学生提出的STEM问题。
snippet: Students in Florida will hear from NASA astronauts Jessica Watkins and Luke Delaney as they answer prerecorded STEM questions while aboard the International Space Station. The Earth-to-space call will begin at 10:40 a.m. EST Tuesday, Nov. 10, and will stream live on the agency’s Learn With NASA YouTube channel. This event is hosted by Freedom Crossing Academy in […]

title: Scientists discover that a clogged filter could revolutionize oil refining
title_zh: 新型膜技术有望革新石油精炼工艺
summary_zh: 科学家开发出一种利用原油自身建立微孔通道的膜材料，可在室温下进行分离，有望大幅降低精炼过程的能耗与碳排放。
explain_zh: 研究人员开发出一种基于多孔聚丙烯腈（PAN）膜的新型过滤系统，能在室温下高效分离原油，无需传统精炼过程中的高温蒸馏。该方法利用原油自身组分在膜孔中堆积，形成小于2纳米的通道，实现对油品组分的精确筛分。实验表明此膜可将炼油能耗降低约32%，碳排放减少约38%，并能显著降低运营成本，具有极高的工业应用前景。
snippet: Scientists have developed a remarkable new membrane that separates crude oil at room temperature, using the oil itself to create microscopic filtration channels. The breakthrough could cut refining energy consumption by nearly 32%, carbon emissions by almost 38%, and operating costs by 36%, potentially transforming one of the world's most energy-intensive industries.

title: 400,000-year-old teeth reveal a stunning twist in human evolution
title_zh: 40万年前的化石牙齿揭示人类演化新联系
summary_zh: 对中国发现的Homo erectus（直立人）牙齿进行蛋白提取研究发现，这一古人类可能与Denisovans（丹尼索瓦人）存在杂交，挑战了单一演化路径的认识。
explain_zh: 研究从中国出土的约40万年前直立人（Homo erectus）牙齿中提取了古蛋白质，发现了其与丹尼索瓦人（Denisovans）存在基因交换的证据。通过对比牙釉质蛋白质序列，研究者确认这些古人类拥有独特的氨基酸变体，且部分遗传特征可能传递至今，影响了现代东南亚及大洋洲人群。该发现表明人类进化并非单一的树状分支，而是复杂交织的河流，揭示了远古人种间存在频繁的基因交流。
snippet: A groundbreaking discovery is rewriting the story of human evolution, revealing that an ancient human species once thought to be an evolutionary dead end may have left genetic traces in people alive today. By extracting proteins from 400,000-year-old Homo erectus teeth discovered in China, scientists uncovered evidence suggesting that these early humans interbred with Denisovans, another mysterious ancient human group. That genetic connection may have eventually reached modern populations in the

title: Hubble Learns Galactic History From Stars
title_zh: 哈勃望远镜拍摄星团Messier 30
summary_zh: 哈勃空间望远镜（Hubble Space Telescope）拍摄的图像展示了球状星团Messier 30的璀璨星群。
snippet: This Hubble image features the sparkling collection of stars named Messier 30 (M30), also called NGC 7099.

title: Scientists discover mysterious “lonely” brain waves linked to memory loss
title_zh: 深睡期的异常脑电波与记忆衰退相关
summary_zh: 研究发现阿尔茨海默病相关蛋白积累会导致深睡期脑电波紊乱，这一微小的脑部功能改变可能是记忆衰退的早期指标。
snippet: Scientists have uncovered a surprising link between Alzheimer’s-related protein buildup, disrupted brain waves during deep sleep, and fading memory. The findings suggest that hidden changes in how the brain processes memories overnight may contribute to age-related memory loss long before Alzheimer’s symptoms appear.

title: Scientists solve 30-year-old mystery and discover a hidden defense against inflammation
title_zh: 揭示免疫系统抵御炎症损伤的隐藏机制
summary_zh: 科学家解决了长达30年的医学难题，发现了一项保护健康细胞免受炎症过度损伤的免疫机制，这有望为癌症和炎症性疾病治疗提供新思路。
snippet: Scientists have solved a decades-old mystery and uncovered a hidden immune system defense that protects healthy cells from the very inflammation meant to fight infections. The surprising discovery could lead to new approaches for treating cancer, inflammatory bowel disease, and other conditions involving excessive inflammation.

title: APOD: 2026 November 5 – Enceladus in Silhouette
title_zh: 土卫二的剪影图像
summary_zh: 每日天文图（APOD）展示了土星卫星土卫二（Enceladus）在背光下的轮廓影像。
snippet: APOD Science APOD APOD: 2026 November 5 –… Today’s APOD Archive Submissions Index Search Calendar RSS Education About Discuss APOD Astronomy Picture of the Day Discover the cosmos! Each day a different image or photograph of our fascinating universe is featured, along with a brief explanation written by a professional astronomer. Enceladus in Silhouette […]

title: Cyprus: Island of Snakes, Cats, and Ophiolites
title_zh: 地质与生物多样性共存的塞浦路斯
summary_zh: 地中海第三大岛塞浦路斯不仅暴露了古老的海底地层（蛇绿岩，ophiolites），还是猫科动物的聚居地。
snippet: The third-largest island in the Mediterranean Sea exposes an ancient piece of the ocean floor and hosts a clowder of cats.

title: Little Ice Age cooling in Europe may have raised the risk of rickets
title_zh: 小冰期可能增加了佝偻病风险
summary_zh: 历史研究表明，欧洲“小冰期”带来的环境变化及工业革命影响，可能导致了18、19世纪人群的维生素D缺乏。
snippet: The Industrial Revolution and climate change may have both contributed to vitamin D deficiencies in 18th and 19th century Europe.

title: Scientists turn viruses into weapons against deadly superbugs
title_zh: 噬菌体疗法助力对抗抗生素耐药性
summary_zh: 国际研究团队发布了噬菌体疗法（利用病毒杀死特定细菌）的临床指南，初步研究表明该疗法在处理难治性细菌感染中显示出良好潜力。
snippet: Scientists are advancing a promising new way to fight antibiotic-resistant infections by using viruses that specifically target and kill harmful bacteria. An international team has released the first coordinated guidelines for personalized phage therapy, offering a roadmap for safely bringing this experimental treatment into clinical practice. Early findings are encouraging, with one study reporting improvement in 77% of patients and the disappearance of targeted bacteria in 61%.

title: NASA Announces X-70 Experimental Aircraft to Advance Flight Research
title_zh: NASA发布X-70实验飞机
summary_zh: NASA推出的新款X-70实验机配备了可重构飞行控制技术，旨在加速先进航空技术的测试与开发。
snippet: On Wednesday, NASA unveiled its newest experimental aircraft, the X-70 Fractal, during the UP.Summit at the agency’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida. This high-performance, highly adaptable research platform is designed to accelerate the development and testing of advanced aviation technologies. The crewed X-70 features advanced, rapidly reconfigurable flight-control technology that will allow NASA to explore […]

title: Uranium cubes reveal why the German nuclear project failed
title_zh: 铀块分析揭示德国核计划失败原因
summary_zh: 针对二战时期德国铀块的最新计算显示，海森堡（Heisenberg）当时严重低估了实现核连锁反应所需的材料量。
explain_zh: 历史研究证实，二战期间纳粹德国的核计划之所以失败，核心原因是其反应堆设计方案存在重大缺陷，且缺乏足够的铀和重水。研究者通过分析幸存的铀立方体并结合历史文档计算发现，海森堡（Werner Heisenberg）严重低估了实现核临界所需的材料量，且受限于战时资源匮乏和技术杂质，德国的石墨堆技术难以达到临界点。此研究驳斥了关于纳粹德国仅差一点即可造出原子弹的猜测。
snippet: "Our calculations suggest Heisenberg significantly underestimated the materials required."

title: NASA Shares Plans to Accelerate Artemis, Return to Moon
title_zh: NASA公布重返月球计划更新
summary_zh: NASA确认了Artemis项目的进度安排，计划在2028年实现人类重返月球表面。
explain_zh: NASA宣布加速阿尔忒弥斯（Artemis）载人登月计划，目标提前至2028年实现月面着陆，并将于2027年执行Artemis III测试任务。该任务将通过太空发射系统（SLS）发射猎户座（Orion）飞船，在地球轨道测试与SpaceX和Blue Origin登月舱的对接技术，以降低未来深空任务的风险。NASA通过精简硬件流程和自主研发关键组件，旨在以更高效、低成本的方式建立持续的月球存在。
snippet: In an update on Oct. 23, NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman and other agency leaders shared the agency’s path to returning Americans to the lunar surface in 2028. Agency leadership provided updates on the previously announced acceleration plans for the Artemis program, advancing toward the agency’s Artemis III test flight in 2027 and Artemis IV Moon […]

title: NASA Announces Ka-Band Satellite Relay Awards for Space Communications
title_zh: NASA布局Ka波段卫星通信中继能力
summary_zh: NASA选中三家公司开发兼容现有航天任务的Ka波段空间中继方案，旨在无需改装航天器的情况下，通过端到端解决方案确保空间通信服务的连续性。
snippet: NASA selected three companies on Wednesday to perform work to develop Ka-band space relay capability concepts that are compatible with current missions in space, ensuring service continuity for existing spacecraft without requiring modifications to their onboard systems. Through this work, NASA will aim to acquire end-to-end solutions that include space, ground, launch, operations, and integration […]

title: NASA Navigation Experiment Shows Promise for Planetary Landings
title_zh: NASA展示行星着陆自主导航技术
summary_zh: NASA成功测试了名为SPLICE的导航与控制载荷，该技术能辅助航天器在月球或其他行星表面寻找安全着陆点，实现自主降落。
snippet: NASA successfully demonstrated technology designed to help spacecraft autonomously navigate to safe landing sites on the Moon and on other planets. An Alta-X drone equipped with the agency’s Safe and Precise Landing – Integrated Capabilities Evolution (SPLICE) guidance, navigation, and control payload completed simulated lunar descent and landing maneuvers Aug. 27. The flight took place […]

title: NASA Space Grant Students Fuel Agency’s Inspiration Tour
title_zh: NASA通过空间资助计划激励青年参与航天
summary_zh: NASA的“灵感之旅”活动通过连接公众、学术界与行业专家，展示航天创新成果，并借此鼓励学生积极投身航天事业。
snippet: NASA’s Inspiration Tour spread the excitement of space exploration and aeronautical innovation by connecting the public, industry, and academia with the people, technologies, and organizations that drive American leadership in space. At nearly every stop across the country, NASA Space Grant has brought students into the heart of the action. In Iowa, NASA Administrator Jared […]

title: New Research Tests Whether AI Models Know Their Own Thoughts
title_zh: AI模型是否具备“自我意识”
summary_zh: 研究人员通过向大语言模型（LLM）植入特定“想法”，探索AI是否存在内省能力。
explain_zh: 研究者通过在大型语言模型（LLM）内部植入特定的激活模式（类似“植入想法”），测试其是否具备自我反思（introspection）的能力。实验显示，模型有时能准确报告并描述被植入的概念，且控制组未出现误报。虽然研究暂不涉及意识问题，但这种实证方法为评估AI是否能够察觉并描述其自身内部状态提供了重要途径。
snippet: By injecting “thoughts” directly into large language models, researchers are trying to map out AI’s capacity for introspection. The post New Research Tests Whether AI Models Know Their Own Thoughts first appeared on Quanta Magazine

title: Earwax’s surprisingly slippery but sticky properties deters insects
title_zh: 耳垢的物理特性可抵御昆虫
summary_zh: 研究发现耳垢兼具黏性和润滑性，这种独特的物理属性有助于防止昆虫误入耳道。
snippet: A comprehensive study of earwax reveals a combination of slippery and sticky properties that may protect against insect invasions of the ear.

title: Scientists may have finally explained why our brains and bodies are cross-wired
title_zh: 人类脑部结构“交叉布线”的进化起源
summary_zh: 研究推测，大脑左右半球分别控制对侧肢体的“交叉布线”结构，可能起源于5亿多年前原始鱼类的视觉系统进化留下的遗迹。
snippet: Scientists propose that the brain’s mysterious cross-wiring, which connects each hemisphere to the opposite side of the body, may have originated more than 500 million years ago in the visual systems of ancient fish. Rather than evolving for a specific advantage, this unusual arrangement may simply be a legacy of evolution building new brain circuits on an ancient foundation.

title: Permanent daylight saving time has a dark side, scientists warn
title_zh: 研究警示永久夏令时的潜在危害
summary_zh: 研究指出，若推行永久夏令时，由于早晨上学时间处于黑暗中，可能使美国学童面临更大的交通事故风险，并干扰其生物钟。
snippet: A new study warns that permanent daylight saving time could force American children to make at least 2 billion additional school commutes in darkness, potentially increasing safety risks and disrupting their biological clocks. Researchers found that fatal crashes involving school-aged pedestrians were roughly twice as likely during dark mornings as after sunrise.

title: A tiny squeeze dramatically changes the magnetism of exotic materials
title_zh: 机械挤压改变交错磁体磁性
summary_zh: 科学家发现，通过简单的机械挤压即可显著改变“交错磁体”（altermagnets，一类具有特殊磁性和电学特性的新型材料）的行为，这一发现有望为研发更高效的电子设备和量子计算技术提供新路径。
snippet: Scientists have discovered that a simple mechanical squeeze can dramatically alter the magnetic properties and electrical behavior of exotic materials called altermagnets. The surprising breakthrough could open the door to faster, more energy-efficient electronics and new technologies for quantum computing.

title: MIT scientists break a 20-year rule and unlock never-before-seen crystal structures
title_zh: MIT打破晶体排列定论，解锁新型结构
summary_zh: MIT研究团队发现，利用柔性分子连接方式而非传统的刚性连接，可以实现纳米颗粒的全新排列组合。这一突破挑战了过去20年的主流认知，为设计具备特殊功能的定制材料开辟了新方向。
snippet: MIT scientists have challenged two decades of conventional thinking by discovering that flexible molecular connections, rather than rigid ones, can unlock entirely new ways to arrange nanoparticles. The breakthrough could lead to a new generation of designer materials with unusual properties and applications in electronics, medicine, and energy.

title: Food contains thousands of overlooked chemicals. This physicist is mapping them
title_zh: 绘制食物中的复杂化学物质
summary_zh: 研究人员正在通过物理学方法绘制食物中被忽视的数千种化学物质，以探索其对微生物群和人类健康的影响。
snippet: Giulia Menichetti is exploring how food’s vast chemical complexity may shape the microbiome and human health.

title: NASA is racing against time to save the Hubble Space Telescope
title_zh: NASA寻求方案延长Hubble太空望远镜寿命
summary_zh: 由于轨道高度逐渐降低，Hubble太空望远镜面临重返大气层损毁的风险。NASA目前正寻求私营航天公司的技术方案，旨在通过提升轨道或升级维护，延续这一传奇观测站的科学使命。
snippet: NASA is exploring a daring plan to save the legendary Hubble Space Telescope from its eventual fiery plunge into Earth's atmosphere. After more than 35 years of groundbreaking discoveries, Hubble is slowly losing altitude, and without intervention, it could fall back to Earth as early as 2033 or 2034. title: How hawkmoths turned their genitals into bat-busting weapons
title_zh: 天蛾演化出生殖器超声波防御
summary_zh: 在与蝙蝠的演化博弈中，天蛾演化出了三种利用生殖器发出超声波干扰蝙蝠回声定位的防御机制。
snippet: In arms race with bats, hawkmoths have evolved three distinct ways to make bat-busting ultrasound using their genitalia.

title: Your voice can now say things you never said
title_zh: 合成语音技术的伦理挑战
summary_zh: 合成语音技术虽能辅助失语者，但也引发了关于诈骗、个人同意权及数字人格存续的伦理考量。
snippet: Synthetic voices can restore speech, enable scams and outlive their owners. These uses raise questions about trust, consent and control.

title: A drug-free diabetes treatment? An implant lowers blood sugar in mice
title_zh: 无线植入物在小鼠实验中降低血糖
summary_zh: 一款无线植入装置在小鼠模型中能按需降低血糖并促进减重，为未来糖尿病和肥胖症治疗提供了新思路。
snippet: The wireless implant rids mice's bodies of excess sugar on demand, and helps them shed weight. It could one day help treat diabetes and obesity.

title: The migration that remade Africa
title_zh: 班图人迁徙如何改变非洲
summary_zh: 6000至4000年前的班图语族（Bantu-speaking people）大规模迁徙，彻底重塑了非洲的文化、语言和遗传格局。
snippet: Between 6,000 and 4,000 years ago, a group known as the Bantu-speaking people began to migrate across Africa, transforming the continent’s cultures, languages and genetic makeup

title: Why large dogs age faster than small ones, and other October research highlights
title_zh: 大型犬衰老速度研究
summary_zh: 近期科研要点包括大型犬为何衰老更快、隐形纹身技术及捕获单个反物质粒子等研究成果。
snippet: Plus invisible tattoos, medieval skeleton gets an ID, trapping a single antimatter particle, and more.
